Fixed: A re-review reads the PR's latest commit: it fetches into a forced ref instead of a branch an earlier review's worktree had checked out, so findings the author already fixed are no longer reported as still open. A pass also keeps the commit its run started on, so commits pushed during a review are checked by the next one.

whats_new.title: Re-reviews see the latest commits
whats_new.text: A re-review now reads the newest code on the PR, so findings the author already fixed stop showing as still open.
